about: Slips in the English of Matthew Henry's Concise Commentary as the CrossWire SWORD module MHCC has it (the build's source, build_wordstudy.py): lines lost, lines printed twice over the next one, two lines swapped, and misprints. Each is checked against an independent copy of the Concise Commentary (Internet Archive item mhcc_20251130, mhcc.txt, a separate transcription with American spelling) and only restores what that copy has; British spelling, Henry's references and everything else stay as the module has them.

commentary.fix_database writes them into WordStudy.sqlite's commentary table (add_commentary_translations.py runs it, build_wordstudy.py runs that), so English readers get the same text the translations are made from. Each `old` must occur once in its section; fixed text is left as it is.
Not fixable this way (the independent copy has the same slip): sections 3392, 3416, 3559, 3591, 3664, 3665, 3697, 3920 (beyond 'know'), 3952 and 4041 (ai-review/README.md, 'Garbled English').
